title: Add public FAQ & Help Center page and footer link

requirements.summary: Create a new public “CloudCam AI – FAQ & Help Center” page rendering the exact user-provided FAQ content and a support email mailto link.
acceptanceCriteria: A new React page exists at a dedicated route and renders the FAQ title, short description, and all Q/A items from the user-provided content.
The Support email is displayed as “infocloudchemai@gmail.com” and clicking it opens the user’s email client via a mailto link.
All user-facing text on the page is in English and matches the provided FAQ wording (including plan details and capture instructions).

file_operations.description: Implement the new static FAQ & Help Center React page and paste in the exact FAQ title/description and all Q/A content (Subscriptions, Camera & Captures, Account & Login, Support) exactly as provided by the user; include the support email as visible text and as a mailto link for infocloudchemai@gmail.com. Use shadcn-ui Card and Separator components to structure the content; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Register a new public /faq route in TanStack Router without authentication guards.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating directly to /faq renders the FAQ & Help Center page.
The FAQ route is not protected by authentication guards (unlike /dashboard, /camera, /my-captures, etc.).

file_operations.description: Add an import for the new FaqHelpCenterPage and register a new TanStack Router route at path "/faq" under the root route, ensuring there is no beforeLoad redirect/auth guard so it remains publicly accessible.

requirements.summary: Add a footer navigation link to /faq alongside Terms and Privacy links with matching styling.
acceptanceCriteria: The footer includes a Link that navigates to the FAQ route.
The footer link styling matches the existing footer link styles (consistent hover/underline behavior).

file_operations.description: Add a new TanStack Router Link to "/faq" labeled "FAQ" alongside existing Terms and Privacy links, reusing the same className styling for consistent hover/underline behavior.

requirements.summary: Style the FAQ page to match existing static legal pages and the app’s visual system (Card layout, separators, typography, spacing).
acceptanceCriteria: The FAQ page uses the same general layout pattern as existing static pages (container spacing, Card styling, section headers, readable body text).
The page remains responsive and readable on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Align the FAQ page layout and typography to match existing static pages (e.g., TermsPage/PrivacyPolicyPage): use the same gradient background, container sizing/spacing, Card styling, section headers, and Separator usage for readability and responsive behavior. Use shadcn-ui Card and Separator components rather than editing any files under frontend/src/components/ui; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
